The '''Kashyyyk oil refinery''' was a structure near the [[city]] of [[Kachirho]] on the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]]. During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] forces attempted to destroy the refinery, aiming to cut off the [[Wookiee]]s' [[fuel]] supply, but they ultimately failed.<ref name="GD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prior to its first [[canon]]ical appearance in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Defense]]'', the refinery was featured in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''.<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>
